item.title: Marionette Mind
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Studio Milk
  • 発売日: 1993-08-27
  • スコア: なし (4 人評価)
  • 日本語名: マリオネット・マインド
  • 英語名: Marionette Mind

别名

  • マリオネットマインド

あらすじ

Marionette Mind is a collection of three interrelated short stories depicting the adventures of an artificially created young woman. Each story is told and seen from the point of view of a different protagonist.

  1. In the first story, a young puppet-maker creates a doll of a young woman that becomes miraculously alive, and very soon discovers her sexuality.

  2. In the second story, she helps a broke performer in a puppet theater to improve his business and life.

  3. The third story is dedicated to battle puppets known as “kugutsu”, where the artificial woman finally finds her home.
